doc.title: tTJS
doc.para: About tTJS This is the class of the TJS2 script engine. You can operate TJS2 through objects of this class.

Constructor The constructor of tTJS takes no arguments. tTJS objects cannot be created as automatic variables. They must always be created using the new operator. The reference count immediately after creation is set to 1. This means that calling the Release method directly will release the tTJS object.

Destructor The destructor of tTJS is protected and cannot be accessed. To release a tTJS object, use the Release method. In addition, it is recommended to call the Shutdown method before releasing a tTJS object.

AddRef void tTJS::AddRef()
Increments the reference count of the TJS2 script engine.

Release void tTJS::Release()
Decrements the reference count of the TJS2 script engine. When the reference count reaches 0, the tTJS object is released.

Shutdown void tTJS::Shutdown()
Shuts down the script engine.
When releasing the TJS2 script engine, it is recommended to call this method before the Release method.

GetGlobal iTJSDispatch2 * tTJS::GetGlobal()
Gets the global object. An object of type is returned. When returning the global object, this method increments its reference count.

GetGlobalNoAddRef iTJSDispatch2 * tTJS::GetGlobalNoAddRef()
Gets the global object. The difference from GetGlobal is that it does not increment the reference count of the global object.

SetConsoleOutput void tTJS::SetConsoleOutput(iTJSConsoleOutput *console);
Specifies the output destination for the console. The console is where error messages emitted by TJS2 are output.
It takes the following arguments:
console
Specifies an object of type iTJSConsoleOutput that defines the output destination of the console. The iTJSConsoleOutput type is a basic abstract class defined in tjs.h and has the following methods:
void iTJSConsoleOutput::ExceptionPrint(const tjs_char *msg)
A method for outputting information related to exceptions. msg represents the message.
void iTJSConsoleOutput::Print(const tjs_char *msg)
A method for outputting other information. msg represents the message.

GetConsoleOutput tTJSConsoleOutput * tTJS::GetConsoleOutput() const
Gets the console output destination.

OutputToConsole void tTJS::OutputToConsole(const tjs_char *msg) const
Outputs a string to the console. msg is the message to output.

OutpuExceptionToConsole void tTJS::OutpuExceptionToConsole(const tjs_char *msg) const
Outputs an exception string to the console. msg is the message to output.

OutputToConsoleWithCentering void tTJS::OutputToConsoleWithCentering(const tjs_char *msg, tjs_uint width) const
Outputs a string to the console centered. msg is the message to output, and width is the width. If the number of characters in the output message is less than the width, it is output centered within the specified width. (Note that all characters are assumed to have the same width, so mixing full-width characters will result in misaligned display)

OutputToConsoleSeparator void tTJS::OutputToConsoleSeparator(const tjs_char *text, tjs_uint count) const
Outputs the delimiter character indicated by text to the console count times.

Dump void tTJS::Dump(tjs_uint width = 80) const
Outputs the state of TJS2 to the console. Results such as the disassembly of virtual machine code in each script block will be displayed. width specifies the output width.

ExecScript void tTJS::ExecScript( const tjs_char *script, tTJSVariant *result = NULL, iTJSDispatch2 *context = NULL, const tjs_char *name = NULL, tjs_int lineofs = 0 )
void tTJS::ExecScript( const ttstr &script, tTJSVariant *result = NULL, iTJSDispatch2 *context = NULL, const tjs_char *name = NULL, tjs_int lineofs = 0 )
Executes a script.
It takes the following arguments:
const tjs_char *script const ttstr &script
Specifies the script to execute.
tTJSVariant *result
Specifies a pointer to a variable of type tTJSVariant to receive the result. NULL can also be specified, but if NULL is passed, the result cannot be received.
iTJSDispatch2 *context
Specifies the context in which this script is executed. If NULL is specified, the script is executed in the global context. Normally NULL is specified, but if you want to execute the script in a specific context, specify the object for that context.
const tjs_char *name
Specifies the name of the script. Usually, the filename of that script is specified. It is used to notify where an exception occurred when an exception notification is made.
tjs_int lineofs
Specifies the starting line (0~) of the script within the document. When a TJS script is embedded inside another document, such as a TJS script embedded in a KAG scenario, specify the starting line of that TJS script. It is used to notify where an exception occurred when an exception notification is made.

EvalExpression void tTJS::EvalExpression( const tjs_char *expression, tTJSVariant *result = NULL, iTJSDispatch2 *context = NULL, const tjs_char *name = NULL tjs_int lineofs = 0 )
void tTJS::EvalExpression( const ttstr &expression, tTJSVariant *result = NULL, iTJSDispatch2 *context = NULL, const tjs_char *name = NULL tjs_int lineofs = 0 )
Evaluates an expression. Refer to ExecScript for arguments.
For operators from which a result cannot be obtained, such as the if operator, attempting to obtain the result by specifying a non-NULL value for result will throw an exception. In this case, NULL must be specified for result.

SetPPValue void tTJS::SetPPValue(const tjs_char *name, const tjs_int32 value)
Sets a variable for conditional compilation. name is the variable name, and value is the value to set.

GetPPValue tjs_int32 tTJS::GetPPValue(const tjs_char *name)
Gets a variable for conditional compilation. name is the variable name. If the variable is not found, 0 is returned.

DoGarbageCollection tjs_int32 tTJS::DoGarbageCollection()
Performs garbage collection. Clears caches held by TJS2 and completes unprocessed cleanup operations.
